relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin, a natural agonist at the TRPV1 receptor, has been studied for its therapeutic role in neuropathic pain.

relationships.subject: capsaicin
relationships.evidence_quote: Capsaicin is an effective treatment with significant reduction in both diabetic and non-diabetic neuropathic pain.

key_findings: Topical capsaicin gives greater relief than placebo and is non-inferior to pregabalin in peripheral neuropathy.
Proposed mechanism involves degeneration of hypersensitized nerve tissue and regeneration of healthy fibers.
